title: SeedVR2 Upscale
description: Makes a video larger and sharper, restoring detail. Its length, motion and sound stay as they are.

labels.66:105:value: Work in chunks (for a long video: slower, needs less memory)

hints: Scale multiplies the size: a 480p video at 2 comes out at 960p.
A larger scale and a longer video both take more time and memory. Start with 2.
For a long video, switch on working in chunks.
If the colours shift, set Colour match to lab, which follows the original most closely.
